style: Say smoothly and warmly, like an audiobook narrator
lines: Same scene, two productions. Press Play Production 1, and tap how you feel as it happens.
Tap a reaction button whenever you feel something.
You have reactions for both. Open Compare to look for a difference.
Viewer 2, press Play and tap your own reactions.
Tap Show splits to find where you reacted differently.
Press Watch to record reactions, or explore the fictional Sample viewers.
Tap a layer to see what each production did here.
Opinion saved. Check that your detail supports your feeling.
